counts_for: a P4 round only; R2 is judged on a separately pre-registered confirmation evaluation, registered only if this round passes on all ten seeds
spec_sha256_rule: sha256 of reach-r4's evaluation report spec block as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces); this round's evaluation must hold the same spec or it is void
motivation: reach-r4 (checkpoint 475, policy 3270ce26...) passed 9 of 10 seeds; seed 1106 failed Q2 and Q3 on segment B, final error 7.92 mm against 7.2 mm (0.055 against 0.05 arm lengths)
warm_start: the prompt asks for one run warm-started from reach-r4's evaluated policy, through init_from / init_from_parent_task (reach-r4's task_bundle as train_status names it) / init_from_task_change; the task revision is the product agent's

per_run.seed_rule: the product agent chooses it at train_start; train_start refuses any of 1101-1110

wall_clock_bound: 2 turns; one run of at most 900 s; one GPU job at a time (machine training lock)
stop_rule: this session's one run has been trained and evaluated (the ledger reaches 5 evaluations), or an evaluation passes on every seed, or 2 turns have ended
supervision: rounds.py --max-runs 5 --max-turns 2 under setsid; the training run under its own cadex_cli.loop supervisor
after: the evaluation's drawn targets are compared with the held-out receipt and its spec with spec_sha256; a mismatch voids the evaluation
